verses.sanskrit:
वैशम्पायन उवाच।
              कृत्वा विवाहं तु कुरुप्रवीरास्तदाऽभिमन्योर्मुदिताः स्वपक्षाः। विश्रम्य रात्रावुषसि प्रतीताः सभां विराटस्य ततोऽभिजग्मुः ॥१॥
verses.english: Vaishampayana said Then the heroic sons of Kuru belonging to the party of Abhimanyu pleased at having celebrated his (Abhimanyu's) nuptials and having rested during the night, awoke at break of day and went to the court of Virata.

verses.sanskrit: सभा तु सा मत्स्यपतेः समृद्धा मणिप्रवेकोत्तमरत्नचित्रा। न्यस्तासना माल्यवती सुगन्धा तामभ्ययुस्ते नरराजवृद्धाः॥२॥
verses.english: The court of the Lord of the Matsyas was richly decorated and adorned with a collection of precious stones and choice gems, with seats arranged in it, having garlands and filled with fragrance. Those aged kings among men came there.
verses.bhavadeepa: कृत्वेति । अभिमन्योः स्वपक्षाः यादवपाण्डवाद्याः तस्यैव विवाहं कृत्वा मुदिता अभूवन्निति शेषः। प्रतीताः प्रबुद्धाः ॥१॥

verses.sanskrit: अथासनान्याविशतां पुरस्तादुभौ विराटद्रुपदौ नरेन्द्रौ। वृद्धौ च मान्यौ पृथिवीपतीनां पित्रा समं रामजनार्दनौ च ॥३॥
verses.english: On the front seats sat the two kings Virata and Drupada, aged and revered among the rulers of the earth and Rama and Janardana also along with their father.
verses.bhavadeepa: मणयो मुक्ताप्रवालादयः तेषां प्रवेको जालादिरूपः समूहः तेन उत्तमरत्नैः हीरपद्मरागाद्यैश्च चित्रा । ‘मणिः स्त्रीपुंसयोरश्मजातौ मुतादिकेष्वपि’ इति मेदिनी ॥२॥

verses.sanskrit: पाञ्चालराजस्य समीपतस्तु शिनिप्रवीरः सहरौहिणेयः। मत्स्यस्य राज्ञस्तु सुसन्निकृष्टो जनार्दनश्चैव युधिष्ठिरश्च॥४॥
verses.english: Near the king of Panchala sat the brave ruler of Shini along with the son of Rohini and next to the king of Matsya (sat) Janardana and Yudhishthira.

verses.sanskrit: सुताश्च सर्वे द्रुपदस्य राज्ञो भीमार्जुनौ माद्रवतीसुतौ च। प्रद्युम्नसाम्बौ च युधि प्रवीरौ विराटपुत्रैश्च सहाभिमन्युः ॥५॥
verses.english: (There sat) also all the sons of king Drupada, Bhima and Arjuna, the two sons of Madri, Pradyumna and Samba, who were valiant in battle and Abhimanyu in company with the son of Virata.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वे च शूराः पितृभिः समाना वीर्येण रूपेण बलेन चैव। उपाविशन्द्रौपदेयाः कुमाराः सुवर्णचित्रेषु वरासनेषु ॥६॥
verses.english: And on the best seats wrought in gold sat the heroic sons of Draupadi who were equal to their fathers in valour, beauty and strength.

verses.sanskrit: तथोपविष्टेषु महारथेषु विराजमानाभरणाम्बरेषु। रराज सा राजवती समृद्धा ग्रहैरिव द्यौर्विमलैरुपेता ॥७॥
verses.english: Those mighty heroes, shining in ornaments and clothes, being seated, that assemblage of kings shone like the firmament studded with beautiful stars.

verses.sanskrit: ततः कथास्ते समवाययुक्ताः कृत्वा विचित्राः पुरुषप्रवीराः। तस्थुर्मुहूर्तं परिचिन्तयन्तः कृष्णं नृपास्ते समुदीक्षमाणाः ॥८॥
verses.english: Then those kings, heroes among men, having engaged in conversation with one another on various topics, remained for a moment gazing pensively on Krishna.

verses.sanskrit: कथान्तमासाद्य च माधवेन सङ्घट्टिताः पाण्डवकार्यहेतोः। ते राजसिंहाः सहिता ह्यश्रृण्वन्वाक्यं महार्थं सुमहोदयं च ॥९॥
verses.english: Those lions among kings, having reached the end of their talk and their attention having been called by Madhava to the affairs of the Pandavas, listened to his lofty speech which conveyed deep meaning. Krishna said

verses.sanskrit:
श्रीकृष्ण उवाच।
              सर्वैर्भवद्भिर्विदितं यथाऽयं युधिष्ठिरः सौबलेनाक्षवत्याम्। जितो निकृत्याऽपहृतं च राज्यं वनप्रवासे समयः कृतश्च ॥१०॥
verses.english: It is known to you all how this Yudhishthira was defeated by a trick at a game of dice by the son of Subala, how he was robbed of his kingdom and how he made a stipulation regarding his exile in the forest.
verses.bhavadeepa: संघट्टिताः सन्नद्धीकृताः महार्थं सारार्थं महोदयं श्रेष्ठफलम् ॥९॥

verses.sanskrit: शक्तैर्विजेतुं तरसा महीं च सत्ये स्थितैः सत्यरथैर्यथावत्। पाण्डोः सुतैस्त्रद्व्रतमुग्ररूपं वर्षाणि षट् सप्त च चीर्णमग्र्यैः ॥११॥
verses.english: The sons of Pandu, who are capable of subjugating the word by sheer force of arms, whose chariots go unrestrained to the celestial or the terrestrial regions and who are true of their words, have fulfilled that austere vow for thirteen years.
verses.bhavadeepa: अक्षवत्यां द्यूतक्रीडायाम् । निकृत्यां छलेन । समयः पणः ॥१०॥

verses.sanskrit: त्रयोदशश्चैव सुदुस्तरोऽयमज्ञायमानैर्भवतां समीपे। क्लेशानसह्यान् विविधान् सहद्भिर्महात्मभिश्चापि वने निविष्टम्॥१२॥
verses.english: The thirteenth year in the forest has been very hard, but this these great men have passed, unknown to you and suffering various sorts of unbearable hardships.
verses.bhavadeepa: सत्त्यरथैः सत्पृथिव्यप्तेजांसि त्यत् वाय्वाकाशौ उभयत्र अकुण्ठितो रथो येषां तैरिति मध्यमपदलोपेन समासः । सत्यं रथवदारोढुं योग्यं येषां वा । पाठान्तरे सत्यैकप्रियैः ॥११॥

verses.sanskrit: एतैः परप्रेष्यनियोगयुक्तैरिच्छद्भिराप्तं स्वकुलेन राज्यम्। एवंगते धर्मसुतस्य राज्ञो दुर्योधनस्यापि च यद्धितं स्यात्॥१३॥
verses.english: Even they who have been engaged in the menial service of others seek their family and their kingdom; such being the case, consider what is best for the son of Dharma (Yudhishthira) and for king Duryodhana.

verses.sanskrit: तच्चिन्तयध्वं कुरुपुङ्गवानां धर्म्यं च युक्तं च यशस्करं च। अधर्मयुक्तं न च कामयेत राज्यं सुराणामपि धर्मराजः॥१४॥
verses.english: (Consider) also what is right, suitable and calculated to redound to the glory of the illustrious Kauravas. The virtuous king Yudhishthira does not want even the kingdom of the gods wrongfully.

verses.sanskrit: धर्मार्थयुक्तं तु महीपतित्वं ग्रोमेऽपि कस्मिंश्चिदयं बुभूषेत्। पित्र्यं हि राज्यं विदितं नृपाणां यथाऽपकृष्टं धृतराष्ट्रपुत्रैः॥१५॥
verses.english: He would rather prefer the rightful lordship of some single village. It is known to all the kings (assembled here) how he has been robbed of his ancestral kingdom with the help of a mean trick by the sons of Dhritarashtra by whom the son of Pritha has not been vanquished through prowess borne by him.

verses.sanskrit: मिथ्योपचारेण यथा ह्यनेन कृच्छ्रं महत्प्राप्तमसह्यरूपम्। न चापि पार्थो विजितो रणे तैः स्वतेजसा धृतराष्ट्रस्य पुत्रैः॥१६॥
तथाऽपि राजा सहितः सुहृद्भिरभीप्स्यतेऽनामयमेव तेषाम्। यत्तु स्वयं पाण्डुसुतैर्विजित्य समाहृतं भूमिपतीन्प्रपीड्य॥१७॥
verses.english: Still the king Yudhishthira with his friends wishes them prosperity. The sons of Kunti, heroes among men and the two sons of Madri, seek only what has been earned by the sons of Pandu by overthrowing the king and winning victory over him. It is also well know to you how, when they were mere boys, their enemies who were cruel, dishonest and who sought to get the kingdom, attempted by several means to kill them. Consider their greediness and also the extreme piety of Yudhishthira.

verses.sanskrit: तत्प्रार्थयन्ते पुरुषप्रवीराः कुन्तीसुता माद्रवतीसुतौ च। बलास्त्विमे तैर्विविधैरुपायैः संप्रार्थिता हन्तुममित्रसङ्घैः॥१८॥
verses.bhavadeepa: अनामयं कुशलम् । यत्तु धनादिकं स्वयमेव समाहृतं न पित्रादिभिः ॥१७॥

verses.sanskrit: राज्यं जिहीर्षद्भिरसद्भिरुग्रैः सर्वं च तद्वो विदितं यथावत्। तेषां च लोभं प्रसमीक्ष्य वृद्धं धर्मज्ञतां चापि युधिष्ठिरस्य॥१९॥
संबन्धितां चापि समीक्ष्य तेषां मतिं कुरुध्वं सहिताः पृथक्व। इमे च सत्येऽभिरताः सदैव तं पालयित्वा समयं यथावत्॥२०॥
verses.english: Consider also the relationship between them; consult together and also think each of you yourself. They have always been attached to truth and have always fulfilled their promises.

verses.sanskrit: अतोऽन्यथा तैरुपचर्यमाणा हन्युः समेतान्धृतराष्ट्रपुत्रान्। तैर्विप्रकारं च निशम्य कार्ये सुहृज्जनास्तान्परिवारयेयुः॥२१॥
verses.english: If they are now wrongfully treated let them slay all the sons of Dhritarashtra or let their friends who see the unworthy treatment they get in this matter make them (the sons of Dhritarashtra) desist.

verses.sanskrit: युद्धेन बाधेयुरिमांस्तथैवं तैर्बाध्यमाना युधि तांश्च हन्युः। तथाऽपि नेमेऽल्पतया समर्थास्तेषां जयायेति भवेन्मतं वः॥२२॥
verses.english: If they (the sons of Dhritarashtra) oppose them (the Pandavas) in battle the letter thus opposed will kill them; and if you are of opinion that the Pandavas, owing to insufficiency of numbers, will not be able to win victory over them let them combine with all their friends and try to overthrow them. The intentions of Duryodhana are not known nor what he is going to do.
verses.bhavadeepa: अतो राज्यार्धप्रदानात् । कार्ये राज्यलाभनिमित्तं तैर्धार्तराष्ट्रैः कृतं विप्रकारमपकारं निशम्य ज्ञात्वा । तान् पाण्डवान् ॥२१॥

verses.sanskrit: समेत्य सर्वे सहिताः सुहृद्भिस्तेषां विनाशाय यतेयुरेव। दुर्योधनस्यापि मतं यथावन्न ज्ञायते किं नु करिष्यतीति॥२३॥
verses.bhavadeepa: यदि इमान् बाधेयुस्तर्हि एतेऽपि तान् कौरवान् हन्युः । इमे पाण्डवाः ॥२२॥

verses.sanskrit: अज्ञायमाने च मते परस्य किं स्यात् समारभ्यतमं मतं वः। तस्मादितो गच्छतु धर्मशीलः शुचिः कुलीनः पुरुषोऽप्रमत्तः॥२४॥
verses.english: The intentions of the other side not being known, how can you determine on what to do yourself. Therefore let a man virtuous, holy, of good parentage and wifeless go from here-a capable ambassador who will be able to pursuable them into surrendering half of Yudhishthira's kingdom.

verses.sanskrit: दूतः समर्थः प्रशमाय तेषां राज्यार्धदानाय युधिष्ठिरस्य। निशम्य वाक्यं तु जनार्दनस्य धर्मार्थयुक्तं मधुरं समं च॥२५॥
समाददे वाक्यमथाग्रजोऽस्य संपूज्य वाक्यं तदतीव राजन् ॥२६॥
verses.english: Hearing this speech of Janardana which was pregnant with meaning and virtue, interesting and impartial, his elder brother accepted the suggestions and after praising the speech addressed him O king, thus.
